screening_basis.text: Ponatinib (BRD-K44227013) ranked first by WTCS score (-0.5167) in the S2 expression reversal screen, based on 5 conditions from the exact S2 AnalysisRun.
In EXP006 (source dataset GSE70138), ponatinib at 10.0 uM for 24 h in MCF7 cells showed WTCS median B of -0.5167 (rank 1, n_signatures=1).
Dose stability was graded low (direction_flip, negative_dose_fraction 0.2, qc_sensitivity_range ~0.098), indicating WTCS direction was not stable across available doses (5 doses).

independent_validation.text: External S1 validation ranks were weak: external_s1_median_rank 3439.0 (5 conditions) and external_s1_B200_median_rank 2879.0; Q2 condition median rank 4271.0 (5 conditions).

PRISM cell viability endpoint (distinct from expression reversal): ER-positive mean sensitivity 1.033 (9 lines) vs ER-negative mean 1.723 (13 lines); sensitivity rank 54 for ER-positive lines and 94 for MCF7 (n_mcf7_conditions=1). These are cell-line sensitivity measurements, not clinical efficacy evidence.

insufficient_evidence.text: No curated target assertions, knowledge graph paths, or disease pathway overlaps were provided for ponatinib; no binding, inhibition, or activation relationships can be stated.
Only a single signature supported the top WTCS result (stability_grade low, evidence_limitations: single signature); no replicated expression-reversal evidence is available.

limitations: Mapping is by exact InChIKey match (CHEMBL1171837); compound identity itself is verified, but the note states no knowledge graph paths, curated target assertions, or disease pathway overlaps are provided.
WTCS reversal score and PRISM sensitivity are computational/in vitro observations, not clinical efficacy evidence.
WTCS_PRISM agreement interpretation notes the endpoints are independent; PRISM sensitivity values do not confirm the expression-reversal finding.
Dose stability was low (direction_flip), so the negative WTCS direction may not hold across doses.
uncited_or_uncertain: Any mechanism of action for ponatinib (binding/inhibition/activation of specific targets) cannot be assessed from the provided data.
The biological condition/disease being reversed is not identified in the provided data beyond condition_count=5.
